nodes.text: Let $\kappa$ be an uncountable cardinal. Must there exist a cardinal $\lambda$ such that every graph with chromatic number $\lambda$ contains a triangle-free subgraph with chromatic number $\kappa$?

#1175 : [Va99,7.92] set theory | chromatic number Shelah proved that a negative answer is consistent if $\kappa=\lambda=\aleph_1$.
